title: Serengeti: The Great Migration
summary: A mobile tented camp that follows the herds, run by naturalists we've traveled with ourselves — built for the days the migration actually moves.
highlights: A mobile camp repositioned to that week's migration
A private vehicle and guide for the full stay
A hot-air balloon safari at first light
A guided bush walk with a Maasai tracker

itinerary.title: Fly into the bush
itinerary.description: A light aircraft to the airstrip nearest that week's migration, then straight to camp.

itinerary.title: Dawn & sundowner drives
itinerary.description: Two full days of game drives with a guide who reads the plains like a page.

itinerary.title: Balloon safari
itinerary.description: The migration from above at first light, then a bush breakfast where you land.

itinerary.title: Bush walk
itinerary.description: On foot with a Maasai tracker — a completely different way of reading the same land.

itinerary.title: Full day with the herds
itinerary.description: Wherever the migration is that week, with a packed lunch and no fixed return time.

itinerary.title: Community visit & camp day
itinerary.description: A school or conservancy project, then a treatment at the camp spa.

itinerary.title: Depart camp
itinerary.description: One last dawn drive on the way to the airstrip, weather and wildlife permitting.

included: 7 nights in a mobile tented safari camp
All meals and a private 4x4 vehicle & guide
Light aircraft transfers to/from the bush
The balloon safari and bush walk
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
excluded: Gratuities for camp staff and guides
